paragraphs.chinese:
这一集里，三个家庭都因为不同的原因整夜没睡。杰和曼尼那个不可靠的亲生父亲一起过了一晚，菲尔遇到突发的健康问题，而米切尔和卡梅隆则为了该怎么哄莉莉入睡争吵起来。

曼尼的父亲哈维尔在又一次错过和儿子的见面后，突然来到了杰和格洛丽亚家。他带来了龙虾、昂贵的礼物，还有一大堆最新冒险经历的故事。曼尼兴奋极了，但杰不信任他。在杰看来，哈维尔是那种总会许下很大的承诺，却很少真正出现的父亲。

格洛丽亚让杰表现友好一点，因为曼尼需要和父亲相处的时间。当天深夜，杰发现哈维尔正在打台球，终于当面说出了自己对他的看法。哈维尔承认，来看曼尼对他来说很难，因为杰已经成了曼尼生活中那个稳定的父亲，而他觉得自己根本无法和杰竞争。

两个男人很快发现，他们都很喜欢棒球。哈维尔带杰和曼尼出去击球，三个人整晚吃热狗、玩得很开心。杰开始明白，为什么格洛丽亚和曼尼总是那么容易被哈维尔迷住。第二天，哈维尔甚至骑着一辆摩托车出现，还说服杰和他一起出去兜风。

杰坚持说，自己只是为了曼尼才和哈维尔相处，但格洛丽亚看得出来，他其实很喜欢哈维尔。后来，哈维尔本来答应带杰去见几位退役棒球运动员。杰一直等着，可哈维尔始终没有出现。到了最后，杰亲自体验了曼尼多年来一直经历的那种失望。

与此同时，菲尔半夜突然出现剧烈的腹痛。他认定自己快要死了，克莱尔只好叫救护车。因为当地的消防员出了名地英俊，克莱尔在他们到来前赶紧换上了更好看的衣服。

尽管菲尔疼得厉害，他还是注意到了克莱尔的打扮，觉得很受伤。到了医院，医生发现他得的是肾结石。克莱尔承认，自己平时大部分时间都穿着旧衣服，在家照顾房子和孩子，那一刻她只是想让自己重新感觉有吸引力一点。

菲尔装出一副以后可以利用她的愧疚，想要什么就得到什么的样子。可在离开医院前，他又开始给一群女人表演纸牌魔术，于是很快就失去了占上风的机会。

米切尔和卡梅隆同样整夜没睡，因为他们正在训练莉莉自己入睡。米切尔想让她哭一会儿，卡梅隆却总是走进房间安慰她。两个人争得越来越激烈，甚至有了肢体拉扯，卡梅隆还弄伤了脚踝。

冷静下来后，米切尔解释说，他不想永远都是那个严厉的家长。卡梅隆同意，他们应该共同承担育儿中负责安慰孩子的部分，也共同承担那些更难做的部分。

到了最后，所有大人都又累又情绪化，表现得几乎和他们平时一直纠正的孩子一样幼稚。
paragraphs.english:
This episode keeps all three families awake for different reasons. Jay spends the night with Manny’s unreliable father, Phil has a medical emergency, and Mitchell and Cameron argue over how to get Lily to sleep.

Manny’s father, Javier, suddenly arrives at Jay and Gloria’s house after missing another visit with his son. He brings lobsters, expensive gifts, and stories about his latest adventures. Manny is thrilled, but Jay doesn’t trust him. He sees Javier as a father who makes big promises and rarely shows up.

Gloria asks Jay to be nice because Manny needs time with his dad. Later that night, Jay finds Javier playing pool and finally tells him what he thinks. Javier admits that visiting Manny is difficult because Jay has become the stable father in Manny’s life, and he feels like he can’t compete with that.

The two men soon discover that they both love baseball. Javier takes Jay and Manny out to hit some balls, and they stay up all night eating hot dogs and having fun. Jay starts to understand why Gloria and Manny are so easily charmed by him. The next day, Javier even arrives with a motorcycle and talks Jay into going for a ride.

Jay insists that he’s only spending time with Javier for Manny’s sake, but Gloria can see that he likes him. Later, Javier is supposed to take Jay out to meet some former baseball players. Jay waits for him, but Javier never arrives. In the end, Jay gets the same treatment Manny has been getting for years.

Meanwhile, Phil suddenly develops terrible stomach pain in the middle of the night. He becomes convinced that he’s dying, and Claire calls an ambulance. Since the local firefighters are known for being attractive, Claire quickly changes into nicer clothes before they arrive.

Even though Phil is in great pain, he notices what she’s done and feels offended. At the hospital, the doctors find a kidney stone. Claire admits that she dressed up because she spends most of her time in old clothes, taking care of the house and the children, and she wanted to feel attractive for a moment.

Phil acts as if he’ll use her guilt to get whatever he wants in the future. But before leaving the hospital, he starts performing card tricks for a group of women, so he quickly loses the advantage.

Mitchell and Cameron are also up all night because they’re trying to teach Lily to fall asleep on her own. Mitchell wants to let her cry for a while, but Cameron keeps going into her room to comfort her. Their argument becomes so physical that Cameron hurts his ankle.

After they calm down, Mitchell explains that he doesn’t want to be the only strict parent. Cameron agrees that they should share both the comforting and the difficult parts of raising Lily.

By the end, all the adults are tired, emotional, and acting almost as childish as the kids they’re always correcting.
